faq.q: Is Titanium High-Load Flange Washer compatible with fluorine-based process chemistries?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has excellent resistance to NF₃, CF₄, SF₆, and other fluorine-based plasma chemistries used in semiconductor etching and chamber cleaning. The TiO₂ passive layer forms a stable TiF₄ reaction product that does not spall or generate particles. However, Titanium High-Load Flange Washer should not be used in HF-containing wet processes where corrosion rates exceed 0.5 mm/year.
